versions.changelog: Add excavationpro listen portal + music lattice skill

- Initial release of lygo-tools-portal (v1.0.0).
- Unified portal for routing users and agents to official LYGO tools, web pages, ClawHub skills, and CLI utilities.
- Always consults TOOLS_MANIFEST.json before linking or suggesting tools.
- Prioritizes sending users to official LYGO Pages and agents to LYGO skills or CLI, avoiding unnecessary duplication.
- No support for auto publishing or git push—only human-initiated publishing allowed.
- Security-hardened; can optionally read mirrored skill or stack root for live tool archives.
